thread:
jules (People Ops): dropping Q&A notes from today's all-hands re: hiring and org updates. i'll keep answers short and link the tracker/FAQ at the end.
marco (Eng): thanks! big ask: are we doing a hiring freeze or just prioritizing? heard mixed things in the live chat.
elaine (Product): seconding that  some PMs got questions from ICs about internal moves. what's the policy there?
jules (People Ops): no full freeze. prioritization across four buckets: 1) revenue-facing product teams 2) infra/runtime (latency & cost) 3) platform for Dedicated/Private delivery 4) compliance/security. internal moves are prioritized and will often be treated as transfers not net new headcount, depending on backfill.
carlos (Finance): to add: each org has an allocation this quarter. moving headcount between orgs needs committee approval. finance will annotate any quota credits from bookings.
marco (Eng): if i have a great candidate with an offer in hand but no approved slot yet, can we fast-track?
jules (People Ops): yes, please tag me and hr-bot will flag the req as "urgent-offer". we aim to adjudicate those within 48 hours.
elaine (Product): will interview loops change? hiring bar?
jules (People Ops): interview loops stay the same. small change: please add one line in the scorecard about "3-month expected impact" to help committees rank.
marco (Eng): curious about seniority mix  are we leaning more senior or junior?
carlos (Finance): we prefer a balanced mix but committee will prioritize senior hires for infra/platform where ramp speed impacts revenue or costs.
noah (CEO): adding context: this is about being careful with spend and hitting product milestones. we're protecting core teams, not shrinking orgs. managers should justify hires with measurable outcomes.
elaine (Product): will there be an org chart update? live Q had questions about "hub" leads and pod ownership.
jules (People Ops): leadership will publish a simplified org map next week showing hub owners and pod leads. its not a reorg but clarifies ownership.
marco (Eng): what about contractors / temps? can we use them to bridge short-term gaps?
jules (People Ops): yes, contractors are an option and handled through recruiting; they exist outside headcount but need budget approval.
elaine (Product): any changes to relocation or sign-on packages?
carlos (Finance): standard packages apply; exceptions for strategic/senior hires require leadership approval. we'll include guidance in the FAQ.
hr-bot: [automated] hiring-tracker link: https://redwood/tracker | form: https://redwood/hiring-form | deadline: Fri 6pm PT
jules (People Ops): i'll post the FAQ and tracker in #all-hands after this thread. ping me or DM for urgent approvals. thanks all. :raised_hands:
